SELECT bg.board_game_id, bg.name, bg.min_players, bg.max_players, bg.difficulty, bg.play_time, bg.image_url, bg.description, c.category_id, c.name AS category_name, s.total_count, s.available_count FROM board_game bg LEFT JOIN board_game_category bgc ON bgc.board_game_id = bg.board_game_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.category_id = bgc.category_id
AND bg.name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM board_game_category f WHERE f.board_game_id = bg.board_game_id AND f.category_id = #{categoryId})
AND #{players} BETWEEN bg.min_players AND bg.max_players
ORDER BY bg.name, bg.board_game_id, c.category_id

SELECT bg.board_game_id, bg.name, bg.min_players, bg.max_players, bg.difficulty, bg.play_time, bg.image_url, bg.description, bg.how_to_play, c.category_id, c.name AS category_name, s.total_count, s.available_count, w.waiting_count FROM board_game bg LEFT JOIN board_game_category bgc ON bgc.board_game_id = bg.board_game_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.category_id = bgc.category_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS waiting_count FROM reservation r WHERE r.board_game_id = bg.board_game_id AND r.status = 'waiting' ) w ON TRUE WHERE bg.board_game_id = #{boardGameId} ORDER BY c.category_id
SELECT name FROM board_game WHERE board_game_id = #{boardGameId}
